title: Equipment & Process Development Technician (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

Black Semiconductor is seeking a hands-on and flexible Equipment & Process Development Technician to support the installation, qualification, operation, maintenance, process development, and ramp-up of our FabONE semiconductor manufacturing facility.

You will work across CMP, wet cleaning, plating, and Graphene processes and equipment, supporting both R&D and manufacturing activities.

This is a flexible, multi-functional role where responsibilities will adapt to business priorities and FabONE needs.

Key Responsibilities

- Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, operation, and maintenance.

- Perform preventive/corrective maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment recovery.

- Act as a first responder for equipment alarms, abnormal conditions, and OOC events.

- Monitor tool health, equipment performance, and process conditions to maintain high uptime and reliability.

- Support CMP, wet cleaning, plating, Graphene and Chemical supply systems.

- Manage critical consumables such as CMP pads, diamond disks, filters, PVA brushes, plating consumables, and chemicals.

- Support process development, engineering experiments, process qualification, characterization, and optimization.

- Support Graphene transfer, wet processing, patterning, equipment operation, and process development.

- Assist Process and Equipment Engineers with tool tuning, recipe optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

- Collect and document equipment/process data and maintain accurate maintenance, qualification, and process records.

- Support development and improvement of SOPs, PM procedures, and equipment standards.

- Follow all cleanroom, chemical handling, EHS, and contamination-control requirements.

- Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, EHS, R&D, and equipment suppliers.

- Support other technical activities as required based on business and FabONE priorities.

Your Qualifications

- Technical degree, apprenticeship, technician certification, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3-5+ years of semiconductor equipment, process, manufacturing, or technician experience.

- Hands-on experience in one or more areas: CMP, wet cleaning, plating, wafer processing, equipment engineering, process development, or chemical systems.

- Strong hands-on troubleshooting and maintenance experience.

- Basic knowledge of pumps, valves, filters, tubing, sensors, motors, vacuum, chemical/fluid delivery, and equipment controls.

- Experience with process development, equipment qualification, calibration, or optimization is a plus.

- Graphene or advanced materials processing experience is a plus.

- Ability to learn and support multiple equipment platforms and technologies.

- Strong problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and documentation skills.

- English proficiency required; German is a plus.

- Willingness to work hands-on in a cleanroom and support a fast-paced startup/new-fab environment.

What Success Looks Like

- Safe, reliable, and available equipment.

- Fast and effective response to equipment and process issues.

- Stable and qualified CMP, Cleaning, Plating, and Graphene processes.

- Strong support for R&D, engineering, and manufacturing activities.

- Continuous improvement in uptime, reliability, process stability, quality, and efficiency.

- Flexibility to support changing FabONE and business priorities.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Martin

Martin is a leading insurance advisory and consulting firm celebrating over 30 years in business. Our insurance services focus on our client’s most important initiatives and opportunities: capacity, resources, operations, technology, due diligence, service, and practical advice. At Martin, our goal is to build strong, lasting relationships with partners who share our values, vision, and commitment to mutual success.

The Opportunity

Martin is a trusted partner to insurance carriers and MGAs across the United States, supporting their most critical initiatives - regulatory compliance, state filings, product development, technology, due diligence, and operational efficiency. As the firm evolves its model to pair deep consulting expertise with proprietary software solutions, we are adding a Sales Engineer to own the technical win across every deal on our platform.

The Sales Engineer is the technical counterpart to our sales team and the bridge between what a client needs and what Martin can actually build, configure, and deliver. You'll lead technical discovery, run demonstrations, design the solution, and prove it out - through proofs of concept, integration discussions, security questionnaires, and RFP responses - so that what we propose is technically sound and genuinely solvable. Because our platform is sold with delivery attached, your solution design shapes both the software configuration and the services wrapped around it, and the scope you validate is the scope our teams commit to.

We're looking for someone who can hold their own with a client's CIO and their compliance officer in the same meeting - someone who understands the insurance business deeply enough to diagnose the real problem and knows the technology well enough to prove the answer works. If you've built your career in or around insurance technology and want to own the technical win on deals that matter, this role was designed for you.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery support: Partner with sales to run technical discovery, surface the requirements and constraints that determine feasibility, and ensure the right questions get asked before a solution is shaped.

Technical demonstrations: Deliver tailored demonstrations that connect platform capability to the client's specific operating reality, not a generic feature tour.

Solution design: Architect the platform configuration and services approach that solves the client's problem and validate that it can be delivered as designed.

Proofs of concept: Scope, build, and run POCs that de-risk the decision for the client and the commitment for Martin.

Security questionnaires: Own technical responses to security, privacy, and vendor-risk reviews.

Integration discussions: Lead conversations on data, systems, and integration with client technical stakeholders and their vendors.

RFP technical responses: Author and own the technical sections of RFP and RFI responses.

Technical validation: Confirm that what we propose is achievable within the stated scope, assumptions, and timeline before it is committed.

Handoff to implementation: Transition each won deal to the implementation team with the context, requirements, and documented solution design they need to start clean.

Who You Are

You’ve spent your career in or close to the insurance industry. You understand how carriers think, how products are built and filed, and what keeps a Product Manager, Chief Actuary or compliance leader up at night. You’re someone who gets energized by solving hard problems with clients, and whose instinct is to listen and diagnose before proposing solutions. You bring a practitioner’s credibility to every conversation that results in key sales and long-term partnerships with clients.

Insurance fluent. You've built your career in or around carriers and MGAs, and you understand how the business actually runs - policy administration, underwriting, product development, filings, and the regulatory pressure shaping all of it. N

As a GTM Readiness Manager within the GTM organization, you will help turn product and business changes into executable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, and Technology to ensure the business is operationally ready to bring new products, packaging, and other commercial changes to market.
You will play a critical role in translating product decisions into GTM requirements, identifying cross-functional dependencies, coordinating operational readiness, and ensuring the end-to-end customer and seller experience works as intended. This role sits at the intersection of product and commercial execution, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to improve how we bring increasingly complex products and commercial models to market.
You will serve as a critical connection point between Product and the teams responsible for bringing product changes to market, ensuring teams are aligned and operationally ready for launch. Own GTM readiness for product and commercial changes , including new product launches, pricing and packaging changes, new SKUs, migrations, deprecations, and changes to routes to market.

•
Identify and manage readiness risks , surfacing unresolved decisions, dependencies, and operational gaps early and driving them toward resolution or explicit risk acceptance before launch.

Improve the GTM Readiness operating model by creating reusable processes, launch patterns, requirements frameworks, and automation that reduce manual coordination and make future launches faster and more predictable.

You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavours.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Creative Directors are responsible to define and nurtur the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.
Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible to define and constantly review the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the Team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.
MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

• Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.

• Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.

• Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.

• Nurtur and Communicate the overall Creative Direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.

• Be aware of Internal and External QA's results to direct the creative decisions in order to ensure that the product answers the main stakeholders' needs.

• Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company’s strategy.

• Be the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team and for the press and corporate management.

MUST HAVE:

•

• Has worked in a creative leadership position of at least one high quality professional entertainment product/property that was shipped/aired/delivered in one of the following industries: XR, Games, Movie, Television, Advertisement or Comic Book industries.

• Be a positive leader.

• Exceptional interpersonal skills.

• Ability to listen.

• Ability to communicate efficiently (spoken and written).

• Fluency in English.

• Understanding and sensibility to capture the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).

• Possess a deep understanding of new trends of XR, gaming and entertainment industries, driving user expectations and behaviors.

• Huge curiosity and openness to research and constantly expand knowledge of virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art installations, etc.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Be familiar with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack and Github.

• Fluency in Portuguese.

• Previous knowledge or experience with VR and AR content is desirable.

• A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences would be a great plus.

• Knowledge of other lean and traditional project management techniques.

• Experience in a technology and/or content development/environment, or related fields.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The HSE Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Own safety on gigawatts of high-energy infrastructure, built from zero. Headcount and sites are scaling faster than institutional knowledge can keep up. The gap between a control written on paper and one actually applied in the field is where fatalities happen.

- Keep a 24/7 workforce running at full intensity, not sidelined by injury. Fatigue, shift work, and high-energy exposure compound on the people running the sites and show up as injuries or claims if no one is tracking them. The work is to catch them first.

- Keep environmental compliance ahead of the fastest build in the industry. Behind-the-meter generation spans multiple states, each with its own air permit conditions, runtime limits, and reporting deadlines, and the company adds sites faster than any manual compliance model can keep up with.

Role Scope

- Own HSE across a leased campus another operator controls, where buildings in construction, commissioning, and live operation sit side by side.

- Review design and commissioning packages for the hazards they build in, and push engineering controls into the drawings before a crew has to work around them.

- Build and run the team. Hire, develop, and hold accountable the sourcing managers for each category, and set the category strategies they execute.

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Founded in 2000. SKG Properties specialises in the development, leasing and management of commercial and industrial real estate.
Joining us means seizing an opportunity to work in a dynamic, industry leading property company in South Africa, where ethic, customer service and teamwork are the foundation of our success.
ROLE OVERVIEW
To design, develop, and deliver learning programs in collaboration with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) while supporting change adoption in a fast-paced project environment. Initially, the role will focus on generalist responsibilitieslight-touch facilitation, basic change support, and LMS managementwith the expectation to evolve into a versatile L&D professional capable of handling advanced instructional design, digital learning, and structured change management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Learning Design & Development

• Conduct basic training needs analysis aligned with project and business priorities.

• Collaborate with SMEs to co-create learning content (classroom, virtual, and e-learning).

• Develop training materials and quick reference guides using tools such as Articulate, Scribe, Canva, and Bob Learn.

2. Facilitation & Delivery

• Support SMEs during initial training sessions, ensuring smooth delivery and learner engagement.

• Transition ownership of training delivery after the first tranche, leading refresher sessions and ongoing capability-building workshops.

• Deliver interactive sessions using blended learning approaches under tight timelines.

3. Change Enablement (Light-Touch)

• Act as a change support resource, reinforcing key messages and adoption strategies.

• Assist in basic communication and engagement activities to support system rollouts.

• Apply foundational change principles (e.g., awareness, reinforcement) without full-scale Prosci-level execution.

4. LMS Administration

• Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) for course uploads, user tracking, and reporting.

• Ensure accurate learner progress data and compliance reporting.

5. Continuous Improvement

• Gather learner feedback and update content for relevance and impact.

• Support the evolution of L&D practices toward digital learning and advanced change management.

Key Competencies

• Strong instructional design, facilitation skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to adapt quickly in high-pressure, project-driven environments.

• Basic understanding of change management principles.

• Proficiency in LMS administration and digital learning tools (Articulate, Scribe, Canva, Bob Learn).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Qualifications & Experience

• Minimum: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Human Resource Management, Education, Training & Development, or a related field.

• Preferred: Bachelors Degree (NQF Level 7) in HR, Industrial Psychology, or Education.

• Accredited Facilitator certification (ETDP SETA).

• Prosci Change Management Certification or similar (advantageous for future growth).

• 4 years experience in L&D, including design and delivery of training programs.

• Exposure to project management environments and digital learning tools.

Performance Indicators

• Timely delivery of training aligned with project milestones.

• Positive learner and stakeholder feedback.

• Effective LMS management and reporting.

• Demonstrated growth toward advanced L&D and change capabilities.

title: Deployment Strategist - Sweden
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

- Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

- Own flagship deals end-to-end - from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

- Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

- Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward

title: Demand Gen / Growth — Founding Hire
description:
your mission
The Role
You are the top of the funnel. Your job is to get the founder into 8-12 qualified conversations per month with supply chain and procurement leaders at target manufacturers.

These are two types of meetings:

• Product meetings - structured conversations with supply chain operators to validate features, get input on roadmap, and build relationships that convert into pipeline over time

• Sales meetings - qualified conversations with decision-makers at ICP accounts who understand what Epoch does and want to see it.

You own everything up to the meeting. The founder closes.

What Early-Stage Outbound Looks Like
This is not a volume game. You will not blast 500 emails and wait for replies. At an unknown brand, every touchpoint needs to earn attention

How to apply

• A short note on why this role fits you

• One real example of how you got a meeting at a company where nobody knew your brand - name the company, the person, the angle you used, and how many touches it took

• Your LinkedIn profile

We will know if you wrote this with LLMs. We screen every application for AI-generated content. Be specific, be detailed, be you. your profile

What You'll Actually Do

• Research target accounts - understand their supply chain, recent news, pain points, org structure

• Identify the right buyer (VP Supply Chain, Head of Procurement, COO, Plant Director)

• Write hyper-personalized outbound that earns a reply from someone who's never heard of us

• Build and run multi-touch sequences across email, LinkedIn, and warm intro paths

• Mine existing networks

• Frame meetings as value exchanges, not sales pitches

• Manage HubSpot pipeline, track outreach, report on conversion at every step

• Coordinate event follow-ups, podcast/webinar appearances, and content seeding that generates inbound

• Work directly with the founder daily

You're a Fit If

• You've done outbound at a B2B startup where nobody knew the brand - and got meetings anyway

• You can research a company and write a message that makes a VP stop scrolling

• You're comfortable working in manufacturing / supply chain / industrial context (or learn fast)

• You think in angles, not templates

• You write well in English. German is a strong plus.

• You're relentless on follow-up without being annoying

• You've used Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot - but you know tools don't replace thinking

• You're an executor, not a strategist. You do the work, not the deck about the work.

Position Overview
The Certified Payroll Specialist will prepare, submit, and track certified payroll reports for all prevailing wage projects across the company. With training and experience, the role will expand to include prevailing wage project setup in Vista and progress toward full payroll processing capabilities. This role supports all major payroll functions.

What You'll Do
Certified Payroll Reporting:

• Prepare certified payroll reports (e.g., WH-347 forms) according to federal, state, and local regulations

• Submit certified payroll reports to project owners, audit firms, general contractors, government agencies, or elsewhere as required using online compliance systems (e.g., LCP Tracker, Dili, Empact, Reunion)

Other:

title: LinkedIn Exec Content Writer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a LinkedIn executive content writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Our buyers, founders and operators, spend their professional attention on LinkedIn, and our executives reach more of them than any company page.

You make our executives sound like themselves, consistently, every week. You interview them, write for them, plan what each of them posts, and edit until it reads like a person, not a brand. Team members who want to post get your help too.

This is a remote role, hiring in Brazil, Portugal or Spain only, working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The Executive Content Program: Run it day to day across our executive team, so every account has a clear voice, a plan and a steady rhythm.

- Voice Interviews: Recorded interviews with executives that become posts close to their own words.

- Context Files: A living file for every executive: voice, expertise, stories and the lines they won't cross, built from calls, talks and interviews.

- Ghostwriting: Ideas, drafts, edits and approvals for executive posts, end to end.

- The Executive Calendar: One calendar across all executive accounts. You decide who posts for each launch and keep topics from colliding.

- Launch Days: Coordinate executive posts around launches, webinars and events so the accounts reinforce each other.

- Formats: Text posts, carousels, short video clip scripts, and posts repurposed from talks and appearances.

- Editing: Every draft gets a human edit. Marketing speak comes out; the person's voice stays in.

- Reading What Works: Track which topics, formats and voices reach our buyers, and feed it back into the calendar.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- You have ghostwritten for founders or executives on LinkedIn, and the posts sounded like them. Send links.

- You understand B2B buyers making considered decisions.

- You know commerce and growth well enough to write about DTC, performance marketing, retention and AI tooling without a briefing.

- You can interview a busy executive for 20 minutes and leave with a week of posts, in several distinct voices.

- You are a sharp editor who cuts marketing speak and keeps a person's voice.

- You know LinkedIn formats and distribution: hooks, carousels, native video, comments.

- You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for research and ideas, and you know where AI stops and editing starts.

HARD DISQUALIFIERS

- No ghostwriting samples for executives or founders.

- Copy that reads like marketing, not like a person.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Production Quality Control Specialist
description:
Quality Control Specialist

Department: Production

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

About Drips

Drips engages people in two-way, compliance-governed SMS conversations - the kind that get responses, drive action, and close the gaps traditional outreach leaves open.

In practice, that means Drips helps organizations connect with their customers through large-scale, automated text and phone campaigns. Our proprietary platform lets clients design conversations, schedule outreach, and route responses so the right messages reach the right people at the right time.

The Quality Control Specialist role is what confirms those campaigns actually work the way they're supposed to before real customers ever see them.

Role Overview

As a Quality Control Specialist, you test our product. You take completed builds and verify, end to end, that they behave the way they're supposed to in real-world conditions - not just that the settings look right on screen, but that messages send on time, calls route correctly, and the experience holds up once it's live. You'll manage a steady queue of cases moving through QC, prioritizing your work so nothing sits and nothing slips through untested.

You will:

• Run functional and regression tests on completed builds to confirm they perform as intended - checking timing, routing, message content, and call behavior against real-world scenarios.

• Own a queue of QC cases from intake through completion, picking up work once Build has finished configuring it and seeing each case all the way through to a clean, documented close.

• Identify, document, and communicate defects clearly, so the right fix gets made by the right team without back-and-forth guessing.

This role calls for a bit more technical depth than some other Production roles - you'll want a real grasp of how the system behaves and why, not just how to click through it.

What You’ll Do

Execute Functional & Regression Testing

• Test completed campaign builds end to end: message timing and sequencing, call routing, audio playback, and digit-press behavior.

• Verify that changes behave correctly across real-world conditions - different carriers, devices, and time zones - not just in an idealized test case.

• Run regression tests to confirm that a fix or change hasn't broken something else in the process.

Own a Queue of QC Cases

• Manage a steady flow of cases moving into QC once Build has finished its work, prioritizing based on urgency, launch dates, and complexity.

• See each case through from intake to a fully tested, documented close - you're the last check before something goes live.

• Keep the queue moving without letting cases stall or pile up.

Partner with Build and Product Engineering

• Coordinate directly with the Build team when a case needs rework, giving them clear, specific detail on what didn't pass and why.

• Work with Product Engineering when an issue traces back to the underlying system rather than a specific campaign configuration.

• Translate technical findings into plain language so both technical and non-technical partners understand what was found and what it means.

Document and Report on Quality

• Document test cases and results in a test management platform, so there's a clear record of what was tested and how it performed.

• Maintain a dashboard of defect results to track trends and flag recurring problem areas.

• Deliver regular reports to leadership summarizing findings, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Examples of Day-to-Day Tasks

On a typical day, you might:

• Pick up a case handed off from Build after a new campaign has been configured and run it through end-to-end functional testing - confirming routing, timing, audio, and message delivery all behave as intended before closing it out.

• Investigate a reported defect, reproduce it, document the steps clearly in our test management platform, and route it to Build or Product Engineering depending on where the

Responsibilities and Duties

We are seeking a highly skilled System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer  to develop, extend, and integrate specialized silicon validation and diagnostics tools for next-generation AI SoCs.

Unlike traditional validation roles focused on executing test plans, this position is responsible for developing the diagnostic software and stress tools that expose hardware failures, characterize silicon behavior, and improve platform observability throughout bring-up and validation.

• Design configuration-driven diagnostics supporting scalable parameterization and workload variation.

• Collaborate with hardware architects to understand new hardware capabilities and identify missing diagnostics.

• Work closely with firmware and validation teams to improve hardware observability.

• Debug low-level hardware, firmware, operating system, and driver interactions.

• Analyze diagnostic output and improve fault isolation methodologies.

• Develop software that enables engineers to reproduce and investigate difficult hardware failures.

• Contribute reusable libraries and utilities that improve engineering productivity across multiple validation teams.

• Experience developing hardware diagnostics, system validation software, firmware validation tools, or low-level systems software.

title: Audio Annotation Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time - protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do
As an Audio Annotation Analyst on the Research team, you will review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of Pindrop 's fraud detection, authentication, and deepfake detection technologies. Your assignments will span audio and video annotation projects based on evolving Research priorities and team needs.
Your primary responsibility will be to produce accurate, consistent, and high-quality annotations across a variety of Research projects. You will also support targeted investigations by reviewing interactions, identifying anomalies, and documenting observations that help Research Scientists better understand model performance and real-world customer interactions.
You will…

• Review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data, assigning accurate labels based on project-specific guidelines and classification criteria.

• Apply established classification criteria to identify potential fraud indicators, authentication outcomes, characteristics of human-generated versus synthetic content, and other attributes relevant to Research projects, including intent recognition when applicable.

• Apply annotation guidelines consistently across large datasets, review existing labels for discrepancies, and help maintain high-quality datasets for model development and evaluation.

• Flag interactions that are difficult to classify or fall outside established guidelines, document observations, and collaborate with Research Scientists to resolve edge cases.

• Support Research investigations by reviewing audio and video interactions to identify potential issues such as background noise, audio quality degradation, IVR process gaps, or unexpected model behavior.

• Conduct targeted interaction and metadata reviews to support customer inquiries, model evaluations, and evolving Research priorities.

• Maintain accurate annotation records and summarize findings, recurring patterns, and classification inconsistencies to support Research analysis and model improvements.

• Handle sensitive audio, video, and interaction data responsibly, following established privacy, security, and confidentiality guidelines.

Who you are
You are…

• Exceptionally attentive to detail, with strong listening and observational skills to identify subtle differences in audio, video, and interactions.

• Comfortable with focused, repetitive review work and able to maintain accuracy and consistency across large volumes of data.

• Able to follow detailed guidelines while exercising sound judgment when encountering ambiguous or unfamiliar situations.

• Organized, self-driven, and able to document classification decision

description:

We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.
What's the Opportunity?

We are looking for a Compliance Officer based in Senegal to join our global team. This role is open to the whole of Senegal and plays a crucial part in our banking relationships, local regulatory compliance, and internal reporting. You will serve as the primary compliance contact for all matters within the WAEMU/BCEAO zone.
What will I be doing?

KYC Onboarding

• Oversee and manage the Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding process for new customers and update existing ones across Senegal.

• Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory requirements related to customer identification and verification, including BCEAO and CENTIF directives.

Transaction Monitoring

• Implement and enhance transaction monitoring systems to detect and report suspicious activities within the Senegalese context.

• Conduct periodic reviews and assessments to ensure the effectiveness of transaction monitoring processes.

AML/CFT Compliance

• Serve as the primary point of contact for AML/CFT matters in Senegal.

• Possess in-depth knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CFT) regulations in Senegal, including WAEMU directives, BCEAO instructions, and FATF recommendations.

• Develop and enforce AML/CFT policies and procedures tailored to the Senegalese regulatory environment.

Regulatory Compliance

• Stay abreast of the regulatory landscape governing the payments and financial services industry in Senegal and the wider WAEMU/ECOWAS zone.

• Interpret and communicate regulatory changes, especially those related to AML/CFT requirements, to relevant stakeholders within the organisation.

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with Senegalese regulators, including the BCEAO, Ministry of Finance, CENTIF, and ARTP (for mobile money services).

Remittance Compliance

• Develop and implement compliance procedures specific to domestic and cross-border remittances in Senegal, including key corridors such as West Africa-Europe and intra-ECOWAS transfers.

• Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements governing remittance services in the Senegalese market, with particular attention to diaspora and family remittance flows.

Risk Assessments
